title: dowel registry item
description: The shape of an item served by the dowel registry, as of 0.14.1. Narrower than shadcn's own registry schema in three places: a file target stays inside the consumer project, a sibling is named by full URL, and a style item extends nothing.

name.description: The item name, which is also its filename: `button` is served at `/r/button.json`.

type.description: `registry:ui` is a component, `registry:file` a loose file such as an accent, `registry:style` a theme or a set that installs other items.

title.description: What the CLI prints while installing.

description.description: One sentence saying what the item is for. Derived from the source file for components, so the two cannot disagree.

extends.description: Only ever `none`. Inheriting shadcn's defaults restores the stock palette that the dowel theme exists to drop.

dependencies.description: npm packages the file imports. Derived from the source, and `dowel-ui` is pinned to the version released alongside the item, because a bare name installs the version that does not have the API yet.

items.description: A full URL into this registry. A bare name means *shadcn's* component of that name, which is how a stranger's Input once landed beside ours.

registryDependencies.description: Other items this one needs. Inside a pinned snapshot these point into the same snapshot, so a component and the sibling it reuses are the pair that shipped together.

path.description: Where the file lives in the registry, for reading rather than for writing.

type.description: What kind of file this is, which decides which alias resolves its target.

target.description: Where the file is written in the consumer project. Must start with `~/` or a shadcn alias, and must not climb out with `..`.

content.description: The file itself. dowel ships content inline rather than by reference, so an item is self-contained.

files.description: The files written into the consumer project. A set carries none: it is only a list of other items.

docs.description: What the CLI prints after installing - what to import, what to do next.
